claim_summaries: The finite-dimensional joint-variance minimax correctly enforces one POVM for all labels; the two-Pauli qubit family has exact collective variance 1/2 although each label individually has zero variance.

For a faithful direct-sum trace with arbitrary positive block weights, the pure-ensemble constraint carries those exact weights and the variance identities scale with the physical trace without inverse minimum-weight factors.

The universal Dirichlet constant cannot be below 2: the three-Pauli frame against the selfcompatible depolarizing 2/3 cloner marginal has collective variance 2/3 and average channel Dirichlet energy 1/3.
For growing families, the minimax includes all labels per dimension, but fixed-support arguments do not provide a uniform bound; no general selfcompatible-channel rounding theorem is proved.
